part_E_verdict: FAILS. Authoring-time refusal is real and correct where it exists (person-state role, admitted role, closed object, exact field sets, semantic class, frozen family), but it protects only the author_closed_result_schema route. Every constructor on the binding/rule/registry route accepts unlawful material and the registry publishes it. Person-state schema roles, actor-semantic participant labels, forbidden-premise/strong-noun relation kinds, numeric scalar leaves and an unsatisfiable actor-indexed mode are all authorable and registrable today.
